focus: Camera inspector position and focal controls, exact units, bounds, and editing callbacks; source review excludes camera matrices and the shared numeric parser.

checks.name: Pinned source and instruction review
checks.method: Remote GitHub fetch_file at the exact base SHA; read startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2

checks.name: Camera position units and ranges
checks.method: Read CameraInspector distanceSlider and DistanceValueButton conversion/binding path
checks.result: Position components remain SI; display units are converted for exact input/readout; exact inputs use Position.coordinateRange; slider usual bounds are expanded through the shared helper. No defect identified in this scope.

checks.name: Focal control bounds and presets
checks.method: Read CameraInspector slider and preset actions plus cameraLensBinding
checks.result: Both focal controls use CameraLens.focalLengthRange; preset values are 24, 35, 50, 85 and 135 mm; same-value presets are no-ops; parent binding validates the resulting lens. No defect identified.

checks.name: Editing callbacks and undo connection
checks.method: Trace CameraInspector callbacks to StudioView editHandler/editChanged and cameraPositionBinding/cameraLensBinding
checks.result: Sliders forward stable field IDs; presets bracket a mutation with true/false callbacks; parent identity includes project and operation generation; exact-value assignments use the scene binding's remember path outside active edits. No missing callback defect identified.

checks.name: Exact camera test coverage
checks.result: UI test asserts 73.125 mm exact entry, slider spoken value, Undo, Redo and saved relaunch. Core tests include invalid focal values, pose/lens persistence, and schema migration. Presence of assertions is not a test pass.

limitations: Host and Apple runtime unavailable; no scripts, builds, unit tests, UI tests, screenshots or accessibility sessions executed.
Source-only bounded review; no runtime, CI, milestone acceptance or release-readiness claim.
Shared numeric parser and camera matrices intentionally excluded.

The assigned precision UI test covers exact focal editing but does not itself cover camera-coordinate imperial input, imported-coordinate slider bounds or focal preset no-op history; those scenarios may be covered elsewhere and were not exhaustively searched.
Support files were read only to trace the assigned controls; no source, tree, branch or ref changed.
